page.title: [XX-Email Receipts-XX]

mailbox.heading: [XX-Mailbox-XX]
mailbox.description: [XX-Order confirmations are read from a dedicated mailbox over IMAP. Monize only reads it: it never changes, moves or deletes a message.-XX]
mailbox.dedicatedWarning: [XX-Use a dedicated mailbox. Every message in the folder is read, so it should hold nothing but order confirmations.-XX]
mailbox.encryptionUnavailable: [XX-This server cannot encrypt secrets, so a mailbox password or connection cannot be saved. Ask the administrator to set up encryption.-XX]

error.title: [XX-The mailbox could not be loaded-XX]
error.body: [XX-The request failed, so nothing is known about your mailbox yet. Try again.-XX]

oauth.heading: [XX-Connect an account-XX]
oauth.explanation: [XX-Google and Microsoft 365 usually refuse a plain password. Sign in with the provider instead: you grant Monize access to the mailbox and never type its password here.-XX]
oauth.providersUnavailable: [XX-Whether Google or Microsoft sign-in is available could not be checked. The manual form below still works.-XX]
oauth.badAuthorizationUrl: [XX-The server returned a sign-in address that is not a secure web page, so it was not opened.-XX]
oauth.notConnected: [XX-The connection to {provider} is not active, so the mailbox is not being read. Connect again to resume.-XX]

disconnectDialog.title: [XX-Disconnect the mailbox?-XX]

oauth.revokeNote: [XX-Disconnecting does not remove the permission you granted. To withdraw it, remove Monize on the {provider} permissions page.-XX]

form.intro: [XX-Or enter the details of any IMAP mailbox. Most providers need an app password rather than your account password.-XX]
form.passwordStoredPlaceholder: [XX-A password is stored. Type to replace it.-XX]
form.passwordRequiredHelp: [XX-Required for a new mailbox, or when the server or user name changes.-XX]
form.passwordKeepHelp: [XX-Leave blank to keep the stored password. It is never shown again.-XX]

test.ok: [XX-{count, plural, one {The connection works. The folder holds # message.} other {The connection works. The folder holds # messages.}}-XX]

settings.folderHelp: [XX-The folder to read. It is opened read-only.-XX]
settings.enabledHelp: [XX-Controls only the automatic reading: when on, Monize reads the mailbox every 15 minutes. Turning it off does not disconnect the mailbox, and Poll now reads it whether this is on or off.-XX]
settings.aiModeHelp: [XX-Whether the poll may use the AI provider you configured on receipts. Recognize with AI and Prepare a profile with AI ask the assistant in the chat whatever the mode, and an AI answer is always a proposal or a draft that you approve.-XX]

aiModeDescriptions.off: [XX-The poll never calls the AI for receipts.-XX]
aiModeDescriptions.on_demand: [XX-The poll never calls the AI. You ask the assistant yourself with Recognize with AI or Prepare a profile with AI.-XX]
aiModeDescriptions.automatic: [XX-The poll asks the AI about a matched receipt that no approved profile could read completely, and drafts a profile for a sender that has none.-XX]

settings.autoApplyHelp: [XX-Off by default. A proposal is applied without asking only when all of these hold: an approved profile read the whole email, the transaction was found by an order number or a reference, or by exact amount and payee, with a single candidate, and the proposal adds up to the cent. A trade confirmation is booked without asking only when its trade profile is approved, it read the whole trade, the price agrees with the shares and the total (a cash dividend that states only its amount has nothing to check), and your ledger does not already hold a matching trade. Everything else waits for your approval.-XX]
settings.profileLimitLabel: [XX-Count profile proposals toward the daily AI limit-XX]
settings.profileLimitHelp: [XX-On by default: an edit a profile proposes from an email is counted in the daily limit of AI-proposed changes, like any other AI proposal. Turn it off when a large batch of stored emails would otherwise use the limit up. Only proposals from profiles are exempt; every proposal still waits for your approval.-XX]

editor.subjectHelp: [XX-Optional, one per line, up to {max}. The subject must contain at least one of them, ignoring case.-XX]

required.heading: [XX-The profile cannot be saved yet. Fix these first:-XX]
required.domainsMissing: [XX-Enter at least one sender domain, such as shop.example.com.-XX]
required.domainsInvalid: [XX-Not a domain name: {values}. Enter domains such as shop.example.com, one per line.-XX]

patterns.sourceHint: [XX-Which rendering of the email the patterns below are matched against. Text is the text part of the email, one line per line break. HTML reads the HTML part: every block and every table cell becomes its own line, so a product name that the text splits over several lines stays whole. The email's Lines view shows exactly what each source gives.-XX]
patterns.globHelp: [XX-Each pattern is matched against one whole line of the email, ignoring case. Use {star} for any text and a name in braces, such as {capture}, to capture a value. Each field takes up to {max} patterns, one per line. To match consecutive lines, join one pattern per line with {lineBreak}, for example {example}.-XX]
patterns.startAfterHint: [XX-Optional. Items are read from the line after the first line containing this text.-XX]
patterns.stopAtHint: [XX-Optional. Items end before the first line containing this text.-XX]
patterns.itemPatternsHint: [XX-Must capture {name} and either {amount} (the line total) or {price} (the unit price, optionally with {qty}), never both. Example: {name} x {qty} {price}-XX]

categories.heading: [XX-Categories-XX]
categories.help: [XX-Type a category name and pick it from the list. The name is stored in the profile, and the category must exist when the profile is saved.-XX]
categories.defaultHelp: [XX-Used for items that get no other category.-XX]
categories.unknownCategory: [XX-There is no category named {name}. Pick one from the list, or create it first.-XX]
categories.rulesInJson: [XX-Category rules by item name are an advanced option: add them to the profile definition in the JSON mode.-XX]

json.parseError: [XX-This is not valid JSON, or it is not a JSON object. Fix it to save or test the profile.-XX]

matching.heading: [XX-Matching-XX]
matching.help: [XX-How the bank transaction an email paid for is found. The strategies are tried in order; the first that leaves exactly one transaction decides, several are ambiguous, and none passes to the next.-XX]
matching.instruction: [XX-Best is a reference number taken from the bank operation description. If there is none, the date and the amount are used. By default the strategies are tried in this order: reference (when the profile has reference patterns), order number, amount and payee, amount and date.-XX]
matching.referenceHint: [XX-The identifier the shop or payment gateway puts into the bank operation, such as a statement text or a transfer title. Must capture {capture}.-XX]
matching.strategiesHelp: [XX-Order number and reference look for the value in the transaction's description, payee or reference number. Amount and payee needs the amount plus a payee signal. Amount and date needs the amount alone, within the window. At least one must stay on.-XX]
matching.referenceNeeded: [XX-The reference strategy is on but there are no reference patterns, so it will find nothing.-XX]
matching.referenceInLabel: [XX-Look for the reference and the order number in-XX]
matching.referenceInHint: [XX-Values shorter than 4 characters are never looked for.-XX]
matching.daysHint: [XX-The window around the purchase date. Default {default}, at most {max}.-XX]
matching.toleranceHint: [XX-How far the bank amount may differ from the email's total. Default 0, at most {max}.-XX]

proposal.heading: [XX-Proposal-XX]
proposal.tagLabel: [XX-Add a tag to the transactions this profile categorizes-XX]
proposal.tagHelp: [XX-The tag is created when you have none by that name. It is shown on the proposal, and nothing is written until you approve it.-XX]
proposal.aiCategoriesLabel: [XX-Let the AI choose the category of items no rule matches-XX]
proposal.aiCategoriesHelp: [XX-When an item matches no category rule and there is no default category, the AI is asked for its category from your category list. The choice is marked as the AI's on the proposal. With this off the AI is never asked.-XX]

kind.label: [XX-Profile kind-XX]
kind.receiptHelp: [XX-Reads an order confirmation and finds the bank transaction that paid for it.-XX]
kind.tradeHelp: [XX-Reads a brokerage trade confirmation and proposes the investment transaction it reports: a buy, a sell, a cash dividend or a reinvested dividend.-XX]

trade.guardsHeading: [XX-Which of the sender's emails it reads-XX]
trade.guardsHelp: [XX-Optional. Each pattern is matched against one whole line of the email, one pattern per line.-XX]

guards.requireLineHint: [XX-The profile reads an email only when one of these lines is in it; otherwise the next profile for the sender is tried.-XX]
guards.skipIfLineHint: [XX-An email with one of these lines is set aside, such as a cancelled order.-XX]
guards.waitIfLineHint: [XX-An email with one of these lines is held and read again later, such as a partial fill.-XX]

trade.fieldsHelp: [XX-The action, the ticker and a total or a price are required, and so is the share count except for a cash dividend. The action is read from its text: Dividend or Distribution is a cash dividend, Reinvest or DRIP a reinvested dividend, otherwise Buy or Sell. Each field takes patterns one per line, tried in order.-XX]
trade.amountsHelp: [XX-The total is the executed amount, commission included for a buy or a reinvested dividend; for a cash dividend it is the amount paid. The price (for a dividend, the amount per share) is a cross-check, and with the share count gives the total when the email states none. An amount that names its currency (US$, C$, USD, €) also sets the currency of the trade.-XX]
trade.rulesHelp: [XX-Which account the trade is booked to. The rules are tried in order against the account text the Account patterns read, and the first that applies wins; {star} is any text. A rule with a currency applies only to a trade in that currency, so two accounts the broker prints the same way, such as a CAD and a USD RRSP both shown as RRSP, are two rules with the same text and different currencies. When the email prints no account text, only a rule whose text is {star} can apply. The default account takes the rest.-XX]
trade.currencyOrder: [XX-The currency of the trade is taken from, in order: the amount itself when it names one (US$, C$, USD, €), then the first currency marker below that matches a line of the email, then the currency of your security for the ticker. A rule with a currency never guesses: when none of the three tells the currency, the email waits for you instead of being booked to either account.-XX]
trade.rulesWithoutAccountText: [XX-There are no Account patterns, so the rules are tried against empty text: only a rule whose text is {star} can apply.-XX]
trade.accountNotTradable: [XX-A trade cannot be booked to this account: it is closed, a cash account or not an investment account.-XX]
trade.accountUnknown: [XX-This account is not in your list: it may have been deleted. Pick another one.-XX]
trade.defaultAccountHint: [XX-The account when no rule applies. Without one, an email no rule applies to waits for you.-XX]
trade.markersHelp: [XX-Text that names the currency of the trade when its amounts do not, such as a line saying the amounts are in U.S. dollars beside a bare $. Each marker is matched against every line of the email ({star} is any text), and the first marker, in order, that matches names the currency. Markers are used only when the amount names no currency.-XX]

discard.label: [XX-Matching emails-XX]
discard.readHelp: [XX-The profile reads each email it matches with the patterns below.-XX]
discard.ignoreHelp: [XX-Every email this profile matches is ignored as it arrives: it proposes nothing. For senders whose mail you never want to deal with.-XX]
discard.deleteHelp: [XX-Every email this profile matches is deleted from Monize as it arrives (it stays in your mailbox). A deleted email cannot be brought back.-XX]
discard.noReading: [XX-This profile reads nothing, so it needs no patterns, categories or matching. The sender domains and subject words above decide which emails it takes.-XX]
